posts.en:
headroom-stats-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Shows real-time token and cost savings from the Headroom compression proxy in the DSH web UI: a Settings dashboard plus a persistent stats line under the composer.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-57d0df00be4f2e5e88ad.html
